ratios.quote: As of April 2, 2026, NCM LLC’s fixed charge coverage ratio was 13.1 to 1.0 (versus the required ratio of 1.50 to 1.00 )
NCM LLC's maximum leverage ratio was 0.39 to 1.0 (versus the required ratio of 2.25 to 1.0 )

parsed.notes: Covenants apply to NCM LLC under the 2025 Credit Facility and are measured quarterly. The filing names the ratio only as a 'leverage ratio' without saying whether it is gross or net, so classifying it as total leverage is an assumption. NCM LLC was in compliance at April 2, 2026.
